parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns the company's Unit of Measure (UOM) Categories. Categories are the seven Procore-standard groupings every company has by default — `time`, `amount`, `length`, `area`, `volume`, `mass`, and `other` — and are returned localized for the requesting user. Use the returned `id` as the `uom_category_id` when creating or updating a Unit of Measure via `POST` or `PATCH /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/uoms`.

items.description: A Unit of Measure (UOM) Category that groups related units (e.g., 'length', 'time').

id.description: Numeric identifier of the UOM Category. Use as the `uom_category_id` when creating or updating a Unit of Measure via `POST` or `PATCH /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/uoms`.

name.description: Name of the UOM Category. One of Procore's standard categories: `time`, `amount`, `length`, `area`, `volume`, `mass`, `other`. Returned localized for the requesting user.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/uom_categories")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
